name: Somali Crombec
rangeDescription: Dry acacia steppes of ethiopia, somalia, and northern kenya
description: A small and virtually tailless warbler with a gray-brown back and buff underparts. There is a pale eyebrow and throat patch.

name: Pin-tailed Whydah
rangeDescription: Very widespread in sub-saharan africa, from southern mauritania eastward to eritrea, southward to south africa; introduced in the southern usa (california, florida) and the caribbean (puerto rico)
description: A small, gregarious, and tame species that is found in wide variety of open habitats including agricultural fields, parks, and gardens. The glorious adult male is unmistakable with its long tail and bright reddish bill.

name: Eye-ringed Tody-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil (southern minas gerais to northeastern rio grande do sul)
description: Tiny flycatcher found in the lower levels of interior of humid lowland forests. Note the conspicuous white eyerings and pale spot under the eye.

name: Southern White-faced Owl
rangeDescription: Southeastern gabon, southern democratic republic of the congo, southern uganda, and southwestern kenya southward to namibia, northern and central south africa, lesotho, eswatini, and mozambique
description: A large scops-owl, but still small relative to large owls. Gray on the back; pale and streaked below with a contrasting black-and-white face.

name: Madagascar Sparrowhawk
rangeDescription: Scrub and savanna of madagascar (except central)
description: Typical medium-sized sparrowhawk. Adults are gray on the back with fine gray barring below; females much larger.

name: Imperial Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Sierra madre occidental of western mexico; probably extinct
description: Learn about Imperial Woodpecker: explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Many-banded Aracari
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northeastern peru, and northwestern amazonian brazil
description: Fairly small toucan found in northwestern Amazonia. Often the most common speices of aracari within its range.

name: Yellow-lored Tanager
rangeDescription: Tropical southern colombia to central bolivia (la paz eastward to western santa cruz)
description: Large and chunky with stout dark bill. Nondescript plumage: entirely olive-green with slightly brighter yellowish throat and upper breast.

name: Purple-crowned Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of southwestern and southeastern australia, including kangaroo island
description: Small green lorikeet with pale blue underparts. Note orange and yellow check patch, purple crown, yellow above the bill, and red patches in front of the eyes.

name: Red-tailed Shrike
rangeDescription: Iran to pakistan, southern kazakhstan, and far western china (western xinjiang)
description: Small, plain shrike of dry, open areas with low shrubby cover. Gray-backed and white-bellied, with a black mask and a rusty tail and crown.

name: Moreau's Sunbird
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern tanzania (nguru, ukaguru, uvidunda, and udzungwa)
description: A medium-sized sunbird. Males are very colorful, with a shining coppery-green iridescence on the head and back and a purple-and-red breast band with yellow sides.

name: Red-headed Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Eastern north america from southern canada to gulf of mexico and florida
description: Incredibly striking bird: adults have brilliant crimson head, black back, large white wing patches, and white belly. These large patches of solid color are unlike other woodpeckers with more intricate patterns.

name: Arrowhead Warbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest and wooded hills of jamaica
description: A small active species found high in moist woodlands. Frequently flicks its tail and often gives impression of being entirely heavily streaked.

name: Southern Bentbill
rangeDescription: Tropical eastern panama and northern colombia (eastward to santa marta region)
description: A tiny well-named flycatcher with a distinctive bent bill like a broken nose. It is olive-green above with paler yellowish underparts.

name: Black-breasted Puffbird
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern panama to western colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Rather large puffbird found from central Panama to extreme northwest Ecuador. Striking black-and-white pattern; especially note broad black breast band and isolated white cheek patch.

name: Lesser Flamingo
rangeDescription: Locally from africa and madagascar to northwestern india
description: The smallest flamingo in the world, with a dark bill and red legs. Note glowing red eyes in adults.

name: Sulawesi Lilac Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Sulawesi and lembeh island
description: A unique forest kingfisher. Largely pale brown with an eye-catching red bill, a prominent dark mask with pale flecks on its upper border, dark wings, and a rufous tail.

name: Puna Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru (vilcanota mountains) to central bolivia (cochabamba)
description: Tiny, plump gray-and-brown bird that looks almost tailless. Males are ashy gray with warm reddish brown on their back half; females are similar, with the warm reddish brown extending farther up the back to the crown.

name: Grand Cayman Bullfinch
rangeDescription: Grand cayman
description: Endemic to Grand Cayman. A small flocking species of brushy and wooded habitats.

name: White-tailed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to ecuador and southern peru (cusco)
description: A small, pale, and active tyrannulet with a small bill. No bright colors; look for bold white eyebrow, pale yellowish rump, and two off-white wingbars.
